components.name: Primary Button

components.css: :host{--desk:#dde2e7;--sheet:#fafbfc;--ink:#191c22;--ink-2:#434955;--ink-3:#5d6470;--rule:#c5ccd4;--rule-soft:#e3e7eb;--navy:#132748;--navy-2:#1d3864;--blue:#1d58c0;--blue-wash:#e3ecfb;--red:#b8231a;--amber:#8a4d00;--serif:'Source Serif 4',Charter,'Iowan Old Style',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Libre Franklin','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--paper-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .07),0 6px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .16)} .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 14px;font:500 14px/1.45 var(--sans);border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--sheet);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s,border-color .12s} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px} .ds-btn kbd{font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid currentColor;opacity:.7} .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--navy-2)}

components.css: :host{--desk:#dde2e7;--sheet:#fafbfc;--ink:#191c22;--ink-2:#434955;--ink-3:#5d6470;--rule:#c5ccd4;--rule-soft:#e3e7eb;--navy:#132748;--navy-2:#1d3864;--blue:#1d58c0;--blue-wash:#e3ecfb;--red:#b8231a;--amber:#8a4d00;--serif:'Source Serif 4',Charter,'Iowan Old Style',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Libre Franklin','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--paper-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .07),0 6px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .16)} .ds-edit{display:grid;gap:8px} .ds-edit span{font:600 12.5px var(--sans);color:var(--red)} .ds-edit textarea{min-height:110px;font:400 16px/1.6 var(--serif);padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--red);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);caret-color:var(--red);resize:vertical} .ds-edit textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: :host{--desk:#dde2e7;--sheet:#fafbfc;--ink:#191c22;--ink-2:#434955;--ink-3:#5d6470;--rule:#c5ccd4;--rule-soft:#e3e7eb;--navy:#132748;--navy-2:#1d3864;--blue:#1d58c0;--blue-wash:#e3ecfb;--red:#b8231a;--amber:#8a4d00;--serif:'Source Serif 4',Charter,'Iowan Old Style',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Libre Franklin','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--paper-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .07),0 6px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .16)} .ds-row{width:280px;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;border-top:1px solid transparent;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding:9px 10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 14px minmax(0,1fr) auto;column-gap:8px;align-items:baseline;font:400 14px/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer} .ds-row:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .45)} .ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px} .ds-row[aria-current=true]{background:var(--sheet);border-color:var(--rule)} .ds-row .no{font:500 12px var(--mono);color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-row .dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);align-self:center;justify-self:center} .ds-row .t{font-weight:500;line-height:1.3} .ds-row .mark{font:italic 600 13px/1 var(--serif);color:var(--red)} .ds-row .sec{grid-column:3/5;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:2px}

components.css: :host{--desk:#dde2e7;--sheet:#fafbfc;--ink:#191c22;--ink-2:#434955;--ink-3:#5d6470;--rule:#c5ccd4;--rule-soft:#e3e7eb;--navy:#132748;--navy-2:#1d3864;--blue:#1d58c0;--blue-wash:#e3ecfb;--red:#b8231a;--amber:#8a4d00;--serif:'Source Serif 4',Charter,'Iowan Old Style',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Libre Franklin','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--paper-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .07),0 6px 18px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .16)} .ds-sheet{position:relative;background:var(--sheet);box-shadow:var(--paper-shadow);border-radius:2px;padding:24px 32px 24px 96px;max-width:620px} .ds-margin{position:absolute;left:20px;top:28px;display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:start} .ds-ln{font:11.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-ring{position:relative;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:62px;height:30px;margin-left:-6px;color:var(--red);font:italic 600 16px/1 var(--serif)} .ds-ring svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible} .ds-ring path{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke} .ds-galley{margin:0;font:400 18px/1.68 var(--serif);color:var(--ink);padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-soft)} .ds-del{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--blue);text-decoration-thickness:2px;color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-ins{color:var(--blue)}

narrative.overview:
Each proposed change is a proof on a sheet. The agent marks the sheet in blueline blue. The reviewer answers in red pencil. A deletion is a struck line. An insertion is new text in the agent's ink, with a caret mark. The reviewer's decision is a hand-drawn ring in the margin with one word: "OK", "stet", or "amended". The interface does not use the red and green line diff of code review.

The world is a cool galley-white sheet on a blue-grey desk, under a deep navy shell bar. Guide text uses a serif at reading size. Interface labels use a sans. Numbers, line numbers, and identifiers use monospace. Hairline rules divide content. Slug lines carry metadata. The density is that of a working desk: three columns on wide screens, one change in front of the reviewer at a time.

The build diverges from the direction contract in two small points. The sheet has a 2px corner and the export popover has a 6px corner. The side columns are 290px and 360px, not 280px and 340px. The build is the record.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks with fixed jobs: blue for the agent, red for the reviewer.
One paper sheet on a desk. No cards.
Hairline rules and slug lines carry structure and metadata.
Serif for guide text, sans for interface, monospace for numbers.
Keyboard keys are visible on every decision control.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Blue belongs to the agent. Red belongs to the reviewer. Do not swap them. Do not use either ink for any other job.

rules.name: The Red Is Not Error Rule
rules.body: Red means a reviewer decision. Warnings and failures use Caution Amber, set between two hairline rules.

rules.name: The Print and Desk Rule
rules.body: Text from the guide or the agent's argument is serif. Text that operates the tool is sans. Do not set guide text in sans.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Change numbers, line ranges, counts in position, and source identifiers are monospace.

rules.name: The Paper Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "a sheet of paper on the desk". Do not put shadows on buttons, rows, or columns.

dos: Do set every agent mark in Blueline Blue and every reviewer mark in Red Pencil.
Do show a proposed deletion as struck text and an insertion as new text with a caret, on the sheet.
Do put the decision word in a hand-drawn ring in the left margin.
Do mark warnings in Caution Amber between a top and a bottom hairline.
Do show the keyboard key on each decision control and each tab.
Do set guide text in Source Serif 4 at 18px/1.68, max 70ch.
Do use the Paper shadow only on the sheet and on popovers.
donts: Don't use a red and green line diff.
Don't use red for errors or warnings. Red is the reviewer's decision.
Don't wrap content in bordered or shadowed cards on the sheet. Use hairline rules.
Don't set change numbers, line numbers, or DOIs in a proportional face.
